description: This file implements the EventService class, which contains business logic methods for managing event entities, including creation, retrieval, listing, updating, and deletion.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: Service layer for business logic related to events.

methods.name: Event create_event(self, *, title: str, description: Optional[str], location: Optional[str], start_time, end_time)
methods.description: Creates a new event with provided details and validates that end_time is after start_time.

methods.name: Optional[Event] get_event(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an event by ID, including attendees list.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Event],int] list_events(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, search: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists events with support for pagination and optional search by title.

methods.name: Optional[Event] update_event(self, event_id: int, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates an existing event with partial data, validating time order if start_time and end_time are provided.
